hypothesis: Sample sign advantage survives when the classifier cannot use original features directly, supporting a residual-path contribution at fixed training budget.
alternative: Joint signed/abs differences rely on original-path co-adaptation or optimization, and do not reproduce in a residual-only classifier.
definition: r=z(x)-z(VAE(x)); u=r/||r||2; z,r:[B,1024]; classifier input:[B,2048], first 1024 coordinates exactly zero in both arms. LoRA gradients still flow through both terms of r.
controls: same head dropout RNG per step
original head-input half is exactly zero in both arms; unchanged nominal head capacity

evaluation.scope: reused development set; not independent final test

criteria.support: macro delta_ce>=0.02 nat and macro delta_auc>=0.01 and each domain delta_ce>=0

novelty: N01-T02 uses original+residual input; D02 sign-only response was unsupported despite T02 training benefit. This removes original direct input in both arms. N04 removed branches but did not contrast equal-norm signed/abs. N05 did not test abs or residual-only signs. Signed is a contemporaneous matched control, not a seed experiment.
stop: after both terminal checkpoints archived and committed
limits: reused 192-video development set, not independent final test
encoder still processes original and VAE images to construct residual
zero original classifier input removes direct readout, not original information inside residual
null is not equivalence or absence of sign information
cross-run T02 versus T04 is contextual only; primary inference is within the paired T04 arms
abandoned_preparation: Unpublished N01-T03 source-template idea was rejected before smoke/claim/GPU launch because a fixed +/-1 coordinate template is invertible and absorbed into the first linear layer; code commit 2ec5039 preserved for audit, no result or experiment count.
